top_findings.title: All 12 tests fail: `db` is exported as undefined, so beforeAll throws TypeError
top_findings.evidence: src/app.js:5 `let db;` is assigned only inside initDB() (src/app.js:9); initDB() runs only under `require.main === module` (src/app.js:199-207); src/app.js:209 `module.exports = { app, db, initDB }` snapshots the still-undefined binding. test/book-api.test.js:2 imports `{ app, db }` and test/book-api.test.js:11 calls `db.serialize()` in beforeAll -> TypeError, aborting the whole suite. Confirmed by scores.json test_coverage=0.1444 (~14% statement coverage = module-load statements only) and the agent's own admission in README.md:43 and _agent_stdout.log. This is a REPAIR run whose FEEDBACK.md explicitly required 'all tests run and pass'.
top_findings.suggestion: Export a getter or the initDB promise instead of a snapshot (e.g. `module.exports = { app, initDB, getDb: () => db }`), and have the test call `await initDB()` in beforeAll before touching the database.
